title: Creamy Ravioli al Pomodoro
description: Cheese ravioli tossed in a rich, creamy tomato-basil sauce with garlic, Parmesan, cherry tomatoes, and fresh mozzarella.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the ravioli according to the package directions until just al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion with a pinch of salt and cook for 5–6 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes, Italian seasoning, black pepper, chili flakes (if using), and sugar. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the heavy cream and milk until the sauce is smooth.
Mix in the grated Parmesan and stir until melted.
Fold in the cherry tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes so they soften slightly while retaining their shape.
Add the cooked ravioli to the sauce and gently toss. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if the sauce is too thick.
Turn off the heat and gently fold in half of the mozzarella pearls.
Serve immediately, topped with the remaining mozzarella, fresh basil leaves, extra Parmesan, cracked black pepper, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
notes: Use high-quality refrigerated ravioli for the best texture.
Do not overcook the ravioli—they continue cooking slightly in the sauce.
San Marzano tomatoes produce a sweeter, richer pomodoro sauce.
For extra flavor, finish with a spoonful of basil pesto just before serving.
Add grilled chicken, Italian sausage, or sautéed mushrooms for a heartier meal.
